手机怎样把消息送到远方？: How does a phone send a message far away?
追踪一条消息经过基站与网络的旅程，比较离线、送达和已读。: Follow a message through base stations and networks, and compare offline, delivered and read.
你按下发送，远处的手机为什么会亮起来？跟着三个编号走一趟，找出路上藏着的帮手。: You tap send. Why does a phone far away light up? Follow three numbered parts and find the helpers along the way.
本地模拟 · 没有真的发消息: Local demonstration · No real message is sent
一条消息从手机经过基站和多个网络，再到另一部手机的示意图: A schematic message route from a phone through a base station and several networks to another phone
绿色实线：本例的有线网络: Green lines: this example’s wired links
蓝色编号：同一条消息的部分: Blue numbers: parts of one message
试试：路上有一段不通，会怎样？: Try it: what happens if one link is unavailable?
把本机移到街道另一端: Move the sender to the other end of the street
本图用两片简化接入区选择 A 或 B。真实网络还要考虑信号、遮挡、容量等；不保证: This diagram chooses A or B using two simplified access areas. Real networks also consider signal, obstacles and capacity; the nearest antenna is not always selected.
改条件会暂停，并从当前记录继续；拖动回看不会真的重发。已经走过的部分不会被搬回本: Changing a condition pauses and continues from the current record. Revisiting does not resend anything. Parts that have already travelled stay where they are.
“送达”说的是本例中手机收齐了消息，不等于人已经看过。真实应用的图标和确认规则各: “Delivered” means this example’s phone has the complete message. It does not mean a person has read it. Real apps use different icons and confirmation rules.
第一小段不用电线: The first little link has no wire
手机把消息表示成数字信息，用无线电信号交给能连接的基站。天线可能在塔上，也可能在: The phone represents a message as digital information and uses radio signals to reach an available base station. Antennas may stand on towers or rooftops. Our gold lines are tracking marks; real radio waves are invisible.
“无线”不等于一路都无线: Wireless does not mean wireless all the way
基站还连着更大的网络。本例让信息沿电缆、光纤和网络设备继续前进；一些真实回程链路: A base station connects to a larger network. This example continues through cables, fibre and network equipment; some real backhaul links also use radio. Routing devices forward using addresses. Words do not find their own way.
对方离线，先别说送到了: If the recipient is offline, it is not delivered yet
把对方连接关掉，再前进。信息停在最后一段之前，收件区还没拼齐。重新接通，再继续。: Turn off the recipient’s connection and advance. A part waits before the final link; the inbox is incomplete. Reconnect and continue. This example keeps waiting parts. Real chat services may store messages or eventually report failure.
Wi‑Fi 换了入口，仍需要后面的路: Wi-Fi changes the entrance, not the need for a network
在家用 Wi‑Fi 时，手机先连接附近的无线接入点，常和路由器装在一个盒子里，再: At home, Wi-Fi connects the phone first to a nearby access point, often in the same box as a router, then to the home network and Internet. A Wi-Fi icon indicates a local connection, not a guarantee that a distant service is reachable.
消息能送远，分享前想一想: Messages travel far. Think before sharing.
这张图看不出消息是否加密，也不能证明谁可信。用真实手机时，请和大人确认收件人；不: This drawing does not show whether a message is encrypted or prove who is trustworthy. With a real phone, check the recipient with an adult. Do not send strangers your address, passwords or private photos. The demo uses a fixed example and needs no name or chat content.
再深入一点：地址、数据部分与不同服务: A closer look: addresses, data parts and different services
这里观察的是联网聊天的一条代表性路径。图中的“网络与服务”把互联网转发和可能的消: We follow a representative online-chat route. “Networks and service” groups Internet forwarding and a possible messaging service; it is not one computer handling every message in the world. Apps, operators, SMS and calls may use different paths, and one app may use many service computers.
三枚编号表示可以追踪和拼回信息的数据部分，不是三颗带着汉字飞行的物体。真实编码、: The three numbers represent traceable parts of information that can be assembled again, not objects flying with letters inside. Encoding, segmentation and assembly occur at different layers. Protocols such as TCP can provide an ordered, reliable data stream to an app; other protocols offer different guarantees. Not all messages have three parts. Loss, retransmission and full protocols are outside this diagram.
位置滑块只改变还在本机的数据接入哪一个示意站点。真实移动网络可进行切换以继续连接: The position slider changes the example station used by parts still on the sender. Real mobile networks can hand over connections, but this diagram does not model signalling, radio strength, coverage maps or charges. Disabling the middle path means no usable route in this example. Real networks may reroute; no alternate route is modelled here.
来源与这张图的边界: Sources and the limits of this diagram
手机、天线、楼房和电缆是可辨认的示意形状。距离、时间、数据部分数量和大小都不按真: Phones, antennas, buildings and cables are recognizable schematic shapes. Distances, time, part counts and sizes are not to scale. Green lines represent this example’s wired links; not every base station uses fibre. Waiting in the model is not a universal promise made by operators or apps.

消息通过本地无线接入和中间网络，不直接从一部手机跳到另一部手机。编号保持不变；位: The message uses local radio access and intermediate networks, not a direct jump from phone to phone. Numbers stay the same; positions, time and counts are schematic.
基站也需要后面的路: A station needs an onward link
最后一段，再用无线电: The last link uses radio again
消息已准备好。本机用无线电接入附近能连接的基站，不是把文字直接抛到对方手机。: The message is ready. The phone uses radio to reach an available nearby base station, rather than throwing words directly to the recipient.
这一部分到了基站。接下来经过本例的有线回程；基站不是旅程终点。: This part has reached a base station. Next comes this example’s wired backhaul. The station is not the end of the journey.
这一部分到了发送方的网络。设备按照地址，把信息交给下一段网络。: This part has reached the sender’s network. Equipment uses addresses to forward it along the next link.
这一部分经过图中合并表示的网络与服务。真实应用的服务位置和数量各不相同。: This part passes through the networks and service grouped together in this picture. Real apps use services in different numbers and locations.
这一部分到了对方的网络。还需要到达对方能连接的基站。: This part is in the recipient’s network. It still needs to reach a base station the recipient can connect to.
这一部分到了对方基站。对方手机接通时，最后一段无线接入才能完成。: This part has reached the recipient’s station. The last radio link can finish when the recipient’s phone is connected.
本机待发送：还没有可用接入连接。: Waiting on the sender: no access connection is available.
网络中等待：本例中间路径不通。: Waiting in the network: this example’s middle path is unavailable.
还没送达：对方接入连接未接通。: Not delivered: the recipient’s access connection is offline.
已送达 · 还没有模拟对方打开: Delivered · Recipient opening not simulated yet
待发送 · 三个编号都还在本机: Pending · All three numbered parts are on the sender
旅途中 · 对方收齐 {{arrived}} / 3 部分: On the way · Recipient has {{arrived}} / 3 parts
三个编号都到了同一部手机。完整消息能显示了；是否被人读过，是下一件事。: All three numbered parts reached the same phone. The complete message can be shown. A person reading it is a separate event.
还没拼齐整条消息。: The complete message is not assembled yet.
本例要告诉朋友“公园见！”你按下发送，远处的手机为什么会亮起来？跟着三个编号走一: This example tells a friend, “See you at the park!” You tap send. Why does a phone far away light up? Follow three numbered parts and find the helpers along the way.
这幅图同时看着两端，按收件区统计“送达”。真实发送方要依应用的返回确认才知道相应: This diagram observes both ends and counts delivery at the inbox. A real sender learns an app’s status through its returned confirmations. Those also need a network; return confirmation routes are not drawn here.
回看会恢复当时的连接和位置，不是真的重发。改条件会暂停，并从这里重新探索；已经走: Revisiting restores the recorded connections and position; it does not resend anything. Changing conditions pauses and explores from here. Parts that have already travelled stay where they are.
